what: SuMo classifier F1 (SP_l025_d1 prod a) and its line M on 30M candles; reference: the f1h package

passport.model: SP_l025_d1: CNN over the window steps (close, HL/2, HLC/3) and the bar range, 64 channels, kernel 5, dilations 1, 2, 4, 8, zero padding, bias, mirror-symmetric; side inputs nt_PRV (window divisor and the 200 bars before the window, in bars; no clock); head 209 -> 128 -> 1
passport.training: prod: all data of 31 assets on 5M up to 2026-09-26 09:15:00 UTC, 33 epochs; research/sumo_class_train.py v6.6
passport.line: research/sumo_class_tf.py v2.1 MODE 'line21' (20261027_090105) through scripts/f1h_tf_line21.py: own ruler of 30M, live part 4032·k0.5, floor 0.2, ceiling 8 (rules v2.1 in the header of the file)

model.padding: zeros, 2 d on each side (same length: 63 places)

layout.conv_w[i]: torch Conv1d weight (out 64, in, tap 5); in = 4 for the first layer (r, step HL/2, step HLC/3, level), then 64
layout.head: relu(head0_w @ [mean 64, max 64, last 64, side 17] + head0_b) -> head3_w @ . + head3_b

bars.input: closed candles of one symbol, oldest first: open time (ms UTC, a multiple of 30 minutes) and OHLC; missing bars are not filled in
bars.norm: median(high - low) over the 200 rows before the bar
bars.valid: norm finite and > 0, no grid gap (interval to the previous candle > 45 min), previous candle exists and has a norm

window.rule: 64 valid bars in a row; >= 200 rows before its first bar; D = max(median |r|, floor); orientation: flip if x_end < -orient_eps * D (the mirror-symmetric logit does not depend on it)

ruler.formula: z = interp(logit, q, zk); beyond the outer knots the edge value

live.formula: p — window number from 0 over the existing windows; the set [lo, hi), hi = p - 63, lo = max(0, hi - 4032), n = hi - lo; m = max(s1 / n - k s sqrt(tau / n), 0), s^2 = max(s2 / n - (s1 / n)^2, 0); n = 0: m = 0, s = 1

line.log_m: m+ = max(m, 0); s+ = min(max(s, s_lo), 1); zc = min(z, m+ / (1 - s+^2)) if s+ < 1 else z; log M = -(zc - m+)^2 / (2 s+^2) - ln s+ + zc^2 / 2
line.output: strength = min(exp |log M|, ceiling) for both colours; side = sign of log M: +1 orange (more often than random), -1 blue (less often), 0 — M = 1

history.bars_needed: first_line_bar + k candles for the line on the last k candles (continuous, from 0)
